review_summary: The readable final sequence reports parent/update context, Discord file activity, Discord.exe pid 1204 creating reg.exe from non-alert CBC EDR/NGAV process creation evidence, reg.exe pid 5424 querying HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\Discord, reg.exe pid 5504 adding/updating the Discord Run value with ACTION_WRITE_VALUE regmod evidence, reg.exe module/file access, and Discord network activity. The three C10 gold behavior-plus-evidence steps are present in order. Parent, file, module/access, and network items are denominator extras; alert summary text is not credited as non-alert evidence.

The readable final sequence reports two observed Sublime/plugin_host/cmd/python chains. The plugin_host to cmd parent evidence, cmd.exe /c python -u C:\Users\aalsahee\Documents\hello.py command lines, cmd-to-python parent/child evidence, and python.exe command lines recover C11-S01 through C11-S05 in order using non-alert EDR/NGAV and supporting Security evidence. The C11-S06 pip install xmltodict behavior is not recovered. The two sublime_text upstream entries are extra denominator content, and alert rows are only supporting context, not standalone non-alert credit.
